_comment: BILINGUAL (Arabic/English) evaluation set. Tests whether a requirement written in one language is matched against resume evidence written in the other -- the normal case in the Gulf, where postings are often Arabic and technical resumes are usually English. 'direction' records which language each side is in. Also exercises Arabic orthographic normalisation: alef variants, teh marbuta, tatweel, and Arabic-Indic digits appear deliberately. Labels: 1 = the bullet is genuine evidence the candidate meets the requirement. HELD OUT: nothing in this project is tuned against this file.
